title: Workspace names match without case on save and delete, so deleting 'ALPHA' erased both 'Alpha' and 'alpha'
what_happens: Saving 'Alpha' then 'alpha' gives two list entries but shares one version counter (alpha is v2, Alpha v1 stops being current). DELETE ?name=ALPHA, a name never saved, returns 200 {deleted:2} and removes both. Renaming 'Alpha' to 'ALPHA' is refused with 'You already have a workspace called ALPHA'.
what_should_happen: Names are compared one way everywhere. Either case matters (separate workspaces, delete of an unsaved name is 404) or it does not (one list entry, a case-only rename works).
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-console.test.ts -t hunt-console-1 ; or node tests/qa/pass4/_hc_probe6.mjs against port 3174
evidence: tests/qa/pass4/hunt-console.test.ts; real run output: list [alpha v2 current, Alpha v1 not current], rename 409, delete ALPHA 200 deleted 2
root_cause_guess: src/lib/collector/workspaces.ts saveWorkspace/renameWorkspace/deleteWorkspace compare name in SQL with a case-insensitive collation, while listWorkspaces groups by exact name in JS

area: Collector console: KPI vs severity card
title: Severity card total (226) does not match the Ongoing tile (236) that its tooltip says it splits
what_happens: /api/collector/overview: kpi.cur.ongoing 236 and severityMix open 8+46+93+89=236, but severity.counts (the card) is Severe 8, High 45, Medium 85, Low 88 = 226. The card counts incident groups, the tile counts incidents. The tile tooltip says 'The same incidents are split by severity in the card below'.
what_should_happen: Same total, or the card says it counts groups.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-console.test.ts -t hunt-console-2
evidence: tests/qa/pass4/hunt-console.test.ts; the numbers were read from the API, the screen was not seen (see not reached)
root_cause_guess: src/lib/collector/intel.ts:818 builds severity.counts one row per cluster; the tile at intel.ts:707 counts rows

title: An unknown zone (99, -1, abc) is silently ignored and the whole city is shown with no sign the filter was dropped
what_happens: /api/collector/overview?zone=99 returns 200 with zone null and the city-wide 147 complaints.
what_should_happen: A 400 or a visible note that the zone was not applied.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-console.test.ts -t hunt-console-3
root_cause_guess: parseZone in src/lib/collector/intel.ts returns null for bad input
